note: Plymouth Satellite / Sport Satellite / Satellite Sebring 1965-1974. gen1 = 1965-67 (V-8-only top Belvedere series, hardtop/convertible; no six). gen2 = 1968-70 (Satellite mid-line incl. sedan/wagon with the 225 six; Sport Satellite V-8 only). gen3 = 1971-74 (Satellite name covers the whole intermediate line; Road Runner and GTX entries are excluded here - see their pages). All Plymouth/Chrysler factory literature counts as ONE source; the several Wikipedia articles count as ONE source. NHRA 1965-70 rows are filed under Belvedere headings (series-level, not Satellite-specific). Engines NOT offered on the non-Road-Runner/GTX Satellite per factory literature: 225 six 1965-67; 440 1967-74 (GTX/Road Runner only); 426 Hemi 1968-71; 440 6-bbl 1969-72; 340 1971-73 (Road Runner only; Hagerty lists a 1972 Sebring 340/240 and a 1972 360/175 - the factory 1972 chart marks the 340 NA and has no 360); 360 4-bbl 245 hp 1974 (Road Runner only).
